projection.purpose: Replay deterministic commands without player layout.

contract.input: The same definitions, seed and ordered command stream.
contract.step: Drive the real session through its public boundary.
Record semantic frames and failures for comparison.
contract.invariant: A scripted host is not an alternative simulation.

test.when: The headless host replays the same versioned inputs.
test.then: The first divergent semantic value is reported by name.
